text.name: moisture_label
text.tool_tip: How much water the air is carrying. It sets cloud cover in oktas, scales the deck's coverage, and picks the intensity band that falls - drizzle under 0.15, torrential past 0.85. It is also the wet gate every storm effect rides: darkening, deck gloom and lightning ramp across 0.25 to 0.60 and do nothing below it. Under 0.02 the sky reads clear and nothing falls at all

text.name: convection_label
text.tool_tip: Vertical energy in the air, bucketed into Stable, Breezy, Turbulent and Severe at 0.25, 0.55 and 0.75. It grows the deck's thickness up to fivefold, opens the anvil past 0.6, drives the auto gusts, picks hail over rain past 0.95 and sets the lightning cadence - but always through moisture: convection over a dry sky is clear-air turbulence and fires nothing

text.name: temperature_label
text.tool_tip: Air temperature. It picks the precipitation family - blizzard or snow below -1C, freezing rain or sleet to 0C, wintry mix to 1.5C, rain or hail above - seasons an auto deck's base between a squashed 400m winter and a lifted 1.2km summer, stretches lightning intervals up to twentyfold by -15C, and decides whether lying snow grows or melts
